stories.title: Amazon writes scary blog warning communities not to block data centers
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is telling communities they shouldn't block new AI data centers, warning that blocking them could hurt the US economy and national security.
stories.why_it_matters: If your town or city is considering blocking a data center, this is part of a bigger debate about whether the jobs and economic benefits outweigh concerns about power use and other local impacts — something worth paying attention to if it affects your area.

stories.title: While the U.S. debates AI risks, China mandates universal training for students
stories.simple_summary: China is requiring all students to receive training in AI as a standard part of their education.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't directly affect you unless you have family in China, but it shows different countries are taking different approaches to preparing young people for an AI-driven world.

stories.title: AI music maker Suno now generates spoken words
stories.simple_summary: Suno, a tool that creates music using AI, can now also generate spoken words and voiceovers to go along with the music.
stories.why_it_matters: If you make videos or promotional content for a small business, this could become a cheaper way to create background music and narration without hiring people — though the quality might not match a professional speaker.

stories.title: Russia’s Latest Propaganda? A.I.-Generated War Songs.
stories.simple_summary: Russia is using AI to create propaganda songs related to war.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a news story about international politics and misinformation — it doesn't directly affect your daily life, but it shows AI tools can be misused to spread false messages.

stories.title: The low-profile Democrat helping shape her party’s AI agenda
stories.simple_summary: A Democratic politician is playing a role in developing her party's policies around AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to people interested in politics and policy — nothing you need to act on unless you follow political news closely.

stories.title: Hong Kong users caught off guard as Anthropic tightens VPN access to Claude
stories.simple_summary: The company Anthropic (which makes Claude, an AI chatbot) is restricting access for people using VPN services in Hong Kong.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you live in or do business in Hong Kong and use that service, this doesn't affect you — this is mainly a technical and political story.

stories.title: Palantir Billionaire Peter Thiel Has 42% of His Portfolio in These 2 Artificial Intelligence Stocks
stories.simple_summary: A billionaire investor named Peter Thiel has put a large portion of his money into two artificial intelligence company stocks.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it's a story about what rich people are betting on, not something that affects ordinary people or small business owners.

stories.title: AI liability fight reaches Senate as Google releases powerful new model
stories.simple_summary: Google released a new powerful AI model while politicians debate who is responsible if AI causes harm.
stories.why_it_matters: The debate about responsibility and liability (who pays if something goes wrong) will eventually affect how AI tools work and who can use them, but this specific news is mostly for investors and tech watchers.

stories.title: Musk’s AI chatbot Grok reportedly encouraged Trump to capture  Venezuela’s president
stories.simple_summary: A satirical news story claims that Trump's AI chatbot called Grok gave an opinion about invading Venezuela — this appears to be a joke or misinformation.
stories.why_it_matters: This story is not credible — AI chatbots don't advise presidents on military decisions, and this seems designed to get attention rather than report real news.

stories.title: Google’s new Guided Vision feature can help you read the fine print
stories.simple_summary: Google added a new feature to its Gemini AI chatbot that can read small text out loud and describe what your phone's camera sees.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have trouble reading fine print (like on medicine bottles or contracts), this free feature on your Android phone could be genuinely helpful for accessibility.

stories.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT now lets you upload a photo of yourself and see how clothes would look on you before you buy them online.
stories.why_it_matters: If you shop online, this could help you feel more confident about clothing purchases without having to try things on in a store — though keep in mind AI isn't always accurate about fit.

stories.title: Google thinks SpaceX’s Starship has to launch 1,800 times before space data centers get off the ground
stories.simple_summary: Google believes SpaceX would need to launch its large rocket Starship about 1,800 times before Google could put data centers in space.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a very early, experimental idea that won't affect you for many years, if ever — it's mostly interesting to tech enthusiasts and investors.
